blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—At the end of the first round of eliminations in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament, National University’s Reinhard Jumamoy emerged as the front-runner for MVP. After seven games, Jumamoy fueled the Bulldogs to a 5-2 record, tied with University of the Philippines at No. 1 in the UAAP standings.
